scope: Reserve curve refinement when a short photographic search selects a better feature-preserving layout; reorder existing poor-grid finalists by colour retention; initialize missing regions earlier while preserving retained-colour coarse openings. No crop, mask, classifier or acceptance-threshold changes.

regular.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

timingDefinitions.timeLimit: Requested solver search allowance, not an end-to-end latency limit.
timingDefinitions.detectionSeconds: Crop detection wall time. Decoding and the source thumbnail are outside this timer.
timingDefinitions.runSeconds: Each runs[].seconds starts after crop detection and source-thumbnail creation. Includes preparation, solving, validation, export, independent replay and per-case artifact writes; excludes decoding and detection.
timingDefinitions.solveAndValidationSeconds: design() wall time, including final validation and generated export data. Excludes crop detection, preparation, independent replay and writing artifacts.
timingDefinitions.independentReplaySeconds: Separate exported-SVG renderer wall time; not part of application solving.
timingDefinitions.browser: Actual click-to-ready latency is measured separately by paint-browser-test.mjs.

editable.method: Saved engine geometry and exact classified mask through production validated conversion, SVG serialization/parsing, editor intersection rules and source-mask replay. No new fitting or crop correction. Not a browser interaction test.

limitations: Numerical pass does not certify recovery of the authors' original cutting paths.
Stonehenge still loses sun rays and Viking shows thin seams.
Fine-checker's independently measured mismatch varies with the timing-limited polishing allowance; it remains below the 3% threshold but is not uniformly improved.
Three complete photos still have no crop; distorted cropping and lost classification detail remain in other cases.
Ten-second search allowance is not a browser click-to-ready limit. The actual browser uses its longer default allowance.

regular.explanation: Refinement ends at a wall-clock deadline. No new routing or finalist preference is exercised by this case; its final polishing checkpoint differs. It still meets the existing release quality limit.

viking.causeLimit: The shorter remaining refinement did not produce a valid good fit. These timings do not establish why the earlier stages ran more slowly.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

stop.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

intervention.method: HTTP source override: block the actual compute worker for 30 s before fitting (empty), or immediately after a real validated checkpoint with error <= 0.6% (keep), or finer paper resolution 700 and original-image error <= 3% (keep-finer), or the new detail-polishing stage with resolution 700 and original-image error <= 2.6% (keep-detail). Cancel-finishing additionally yields for 2 s in finalization. No geometry, counts or seed is supplied.

testPolicy.reason: Viking is a functional quality regression with a longer allowance, not a reliable ten-second unit-test gate. The separate complete ten-second corpus remains unchanged and retains its failure. No image, feature, geometry or paper thresholds are relaxed.
